# `assets/import/ObjImporter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/ObjImporter.js`

engine/assets/import/ObjImporter.js — Wavefront OBJ (+ optional MTL) → EngineModel.  OBJ is static geometry + simple material references. We preserve groups/objects and per-face material assignment by splitting into one primitive per material group. Polygons are triangulated (fan). MTL parsing is light (names + a few PBR-ish factors) and the full material decode happens in Phase 2.

## Functions

### `parseMtl(text)`

Parse a minimal MTL into a map of name → material descriptor.

### `importObj(data, opts = {})`

Import OBJ text/bytes into an EngineModel.

**Parameters:**

- `data` *(string|Uint8Array)* — OBJ source
- `[opts]` *(object)* — { name, mtl: Map|string (mtl source) }
